name: ifay-umbrella-workspace
description: iFay umbrella specification, authoritative FayManifest schema, official @ifay/sdk, @ifay/ifacts conformance harness, and @ifay/mcp-server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ifay/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@ifay/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/ifay-sdk/tests/*.test.mjs packages/ifacts-harness/tests/*.test.mjs packages/mcp-server/test/*.test.js && node schema/faymanifest/generator/validate-fixtures.mjs
